solutions.title: Scan stack
solutions.strategy: Keep the full push stack and frequencies, scanning backward on pop for the newest max-frequency value.

timeComplexity.explanation: A pop may scan the full stack.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack and frequency map retain live pushes.

solutions.title: Frequency stacks
solutions.strategy: Map each frequency to a stack of values that reached it and track the current maximum frequency.

timeComplexity.explanation: Push and pop update constant-time maps/stacks.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Every push is represented in one frequency stack.
